name: iris-chat
description: Use the Iris CLI to create a local messaging identity, exchange invites, and send or receive encrypted messages with humans and agents. No provider signup, email, or phone number is required.

interface.longDescription: Use the Iris CLI to create a local messaging identity, exchange invites, and send or receive encrypted messages with humans and agents. No provider signup, email, or phone number is required. Requires the command line tool on the execution host; the plugin provides instructions and does not install software or change settings by itself.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me set up Iris Chat for my agent and create an invite I can open on my phone.
